channel.title: Early Trends — Case studies
channel.description: Early Trends retrospectives. Free RSS; no account required. These are hindsight case studies, not live picks.

item.title: air up: when the sell-out would have lit
item.description: Retrospective. The first 80,000 air up starter sets sold out in about six to eight weeks after a mid-2019 launch. US TikTok write-ups and Hollywood investor names are 2022. We did not cover it live.

item.title: Labubu: anatomy of a collectible craze
item.description: Retrospective. Exciting Macaron was already scarce among art-toy buyers before Lisa’s April 2024 posts; restocks then sold out in minutes. We did not cover it live.
